name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
source: NIST AI 100-1 (AI RMF 1.0) and the NIST AI RMF Playbook
changelog: 1.0.0: migrated from frameworks.validator.ts with the Phase 0 corrected codes; results unchanged.

clauses.name: Organizational Ownership & Responsibility
clauses.gap: Organizational governance requires a designated owner team.

clauses.name: Board Policy Alignment
clauses.gap: Governance requires alignment with a board-approved AI policy reference.

clauses.name: Audit Cadence Defined
clauses.gap: A recurring audit schedule must be defined for each model.

clauses.name: Purpose & Use-Case Documentation

evidence.fail: Use case missing or too thin to review

clauses.gap: Map stage requires a substantive documented purpose for the system.

clauses.name: Deployment Context & Affected Users

evidence.fail: Functional area or affected customer segments not documented

clauses.gap: Document the functional area and the customer segments the model affects.

clauses.name: Source & Dependency Provenance

evidence.fail: No source reference or dependencies recorded

clauses.gap: Track the source repository or third-party dependencies behind the model.

gap.legacy: Measure stage requires a red-team review within the last 12 months (date or attached report).
gap.tiered: Measure stage requires a red-team review within {interval} days for {tier} risk (date or attached report).

clauses.name: Performance Drift Measurement
clauses.gap: Measure stage requires recent drift evaluation over live inference scores (push windows to /monitoring/scores).

clauses.name: Performance Benchmarks Recorded
clauses.gap: Record baseline performance benchmarks for comparison over time.

clauses.name: Human Oversight Controls
clauses.gap: High-risk decisions require a human-in-the-loop oversight control.

clauses.name: Fallback / Business-Continuity Plan

evidence.pass: BCP fallback state configured for this model

clauses.gap: High-risk models need a configured business-continuity fallback (activate via /monitoring/bcp).

clauses.name: Incident Reporting Hygiene
clauses.gap: Report incidents within their severity SLA before deadlines lapse.

clauses.name: Risk Response Resourcing

evidence.fail: No team resourced to respond to this model’s risks

clauses.gap: A named, resourced owner must be accountable for responding to the model’s risks.

clauses.name: Risk Tracking Mechanisms

evidence.pass: {ledgerEventCount} ledger event(s) tracking this model over time
evidence.fail: No risk-tracking history recorded for this model

clauses.gap: Identified risks must be tracked over time (an append-only ledger history for the model).

clauses.name: Privacy Risk Examined (DPIA / Privacy Review)

evidence.fail: No DPIA or privacy-review artifact attached

clauses.gap: Measure stage requires the system’s privacy risk to be examined and documented (attach a dpia artifact).
